title: 第5章 发现目标第6章 追美女
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 砰的一声响，王远滕嘴里发出一声哀嚎声，左眼直接打成了乌眼青，当然一切还没有结束。
那就是迎来了一阵疾风暴雨般的拳头，郑元一边打一边狠狠地说着：“你个垃圾玩意，居然连小爷我的妹妹都敢欺负。”
小妹就是自己的掌上明珠，从小就乖巧懂事，温柔体贴。
虽然不是亲妹妹，但和亲妹妹也没什么区别。
要不是自己活过来了，小妹此时已经清白之身都没了。
这对一个姑娘来说以后还怎么见人，怎么活。
所以就是王远滕他爹在场也要教训下这个狗东西。
郑元一出手更是毫不留情，因为亲人就是自己的逆鳞。
“郑元，你敢打我，我爹一定不会放过你的，哎呦。”
王远滕开始还放着狠话，不大一会就连连求饶了。
“哥，别打了，人都要让你给打死了……”
郑萱看着跟死狗一样的王远滕心里暗暗解恨着，不过这家伙是浩城狱长家的大公子，真要是给打死了，哥哥就会惹上大麻烦。
所以郑萱赶紧跑过来拉着哥哥郑元的胳膊。
“滚吧，下次要是再让小爷遇到你一次就揍你一次。”
郑元自然不怕王远滕他爹，不过现在父母病了，小妹没有自保之力，所以还是停下了手。
王远滕被手下搀扶起后一瘸一拐的走了，不过出了院子后眼睛里闪过一丝阴毒之色。
今天这个仇本公子先记下了，咱们等着瞧。
呜呜呜！
郑萱紧紧抱着哥哥郑元哭的稀里哗啦。
“小妹，没事了，哥哥回来了，以后再也没人敢欺负你了。”
郑元轻轻拍了拍小妹的肩膀安慰着，突然鼻子使劲一吸，一股刺鼻的味道从不远处传了过来。
“不好，药都要煎糊了。”
郑萱赶紧跑了过去，此时郑元已经进屋了。
炕上的父亲郑大海和母亲紧闭着双眼，脸色一片苍白。
“哥，族长派医师来看过了，说爹和娘因为伤心过度，又加上陈年旧疾，恐怕熬不过一个月了……”
郑萱进屋后哭着说着爹娘的病情，郑元不由心里一酸，爹娘最疼爱自己了，为了自己修炼更是舍不得吃，穿。
当年爹为了给自己获得更多修炼灵石，独自上山去打野兽，受了内伤后一直没有痊愈。
“小妹你放心，我一定会治好爹娘的病。”
郑元给父亲和母亲把了一会脉后坚定的说道。
爹娘的病情不轻，不过对于自己来说不过是小菜一碟。
因为那颗珠子里就有各种高明的医术。
“哥你还会治病，以前我怎么不知道啊？”
郑萱一脸惊诧，哥哥可是从来都没有学过医术。
“还有你是怎么从悬崖下逃生的？”
“我遇到一位仙人，是她救了你哥我，还传授了不少武功秘籍和仙法。”
郑元自然不能把真相都说出来，毕竟是和瑶池女帝双修才活过来的。
当着妹妹面前说真话也太难以启齿了。
“太好了，哥，你是最棒的，爹娘一定能治好。”
郑萱搂着哥哥郑元的胳膊一脸兴奋说着，从小自己就对哥哥崇拜不已，小时候到大，别人欺负自己都是哥哥给打跑的，就像今天一样。
郑元笑了笑，爹娘的病需要用金针刺穴法治疗，还要用药草辅助治疗。
“小妹，我出去一趟，需要买些东西，等爹娘醒了你先把那汤药给他们服下。”
郑元嘱咐一下小妹郑萱带着银子出门了。
content_en:
There was a bang, and Wang Yuanteng let out a wailing sound, and his left eye was turned black and blue. Of course, it was not over yet.
That was when a storm of fists came. Zheng Yuan said fiercely while fighting: "You piece of trash, you dare to even bully my sister."
My little sister is the apple of my eye. She has been well-behaved, sensible, gentle and considerate since she was a child.
Although she is not a biological sister, she is no different from her biological sister.
If he hadn't come back to life, the little sister's innocence would have been lost by now.
How will a girl meet people and live her life in the future?
So even if Wang Yuanteng's father was present, he would teach this piece of shit a lesson.
Zheng Yuan was even more ruthless when he took action, because his relatives were his enemies.
"Zheng Yuan, if you dare to hit me, my father will never let you go. Ouch."
Wang Yuanteng used harsh words at first, but soon he begged for mercy.
"Brother, stop fighting, people will be beaten to death by you..."
Zheng Xuan looked at Wang Yuanteng who looked like a dead dog and secretly resented him, but this guy was the eldest son of the warden's family in Haocheng. If he was beaten to death, his brother would be in big trouble.
So Zheng Xuan quickly ran over and took her brother Zheng Yuan's arm.
"Go away. If I meet you again next time, I'll beat you up."
Zheng Yuan was naturally not afraid of Wang Yuanteng's father, but now that his parents were ill and his younger sister had no ability to protect herself, he stopped.
Wang Yuanteng was helped up by his men and limped away, but after leaving the yard, a sinister look flashed in his eyes.
Today, Mr. Qiu has taken note of it first, and we will wait and see.
Woohoo!
Zheng Xuan hugged her brother Zheng Yuan tightly and cried.
"Little sister, it's okay. Brother is back. No one will dare to bully you again."
Zheng Yuan gently patted the younger sister's shoulder to comfort him. Suddenly, he sniffed hard, and a pungent smell came from not far away.
"No, the medicine is almost burnt."
Zheng Xuan hurried over and Zheng Yuan had already entered the house.
Father Zheng Dahai and mother on the kang had their eyes closed tightly and their faces were pale.
"Brother, the patriarch sent a doctor to see me. He said that my father and mother were too sad and had old illnesses. I'm afraid they won't be able to survive a month..."
After Zheng Xuan entered the house, she cried and talked about her parents' illness. Zheng Yuan couldn't help but feel sad. His parents loved him the most, and they were even more reluctant to eat and wear them for the sake of his own cultivation.
Back then, in order to obtain more spiritual cultivation stones for myself, my father went up to the mountains to fight wild beasts alone. He suffered internal injuries and never recovered.
"Don't worry, little sister, I will definitely cure your father and mother's illness."
Zheng Yuan checked the pulses of his father and mother for a while and then said firmly.
My parents' condition is not serious, but for me, it's just a piece of cake.
Because there are all kinds of superb medical skills in that bead.
"Brother, you can also treat diseases. Why didn't I know that before?"
Zheng Xuan looked surprised. Her brother had never learned medical skills.
"And how did you escape from the cliff?"
"I met an immortal. She saved your brother and me, and she also taught me many martial arts secrets and immortal techniques."
Naturally, Zheng Yuan couldn't tell the whole truth. After all, he only came to life through dual cultivation with the Empress of Yaochi.
It was too hard to tell the truth in front of my sister.
"That's great, brother, you are the best. Mom and dad will definitely be able to cure it."
Zheng Xuan hugged her brother Zheng Yuan's arm and said excitedly. She has admired her brother since she was a child. When she was a child, her brother would beat others away when they bullied her, just like today.
Zheng Yuan smiled. His parents' illness needed to be treated with gold acupuncture and medicinal herbs.
"Little sister, I'm going out and need to buy some things. When my parents wake up, you can give them the soup and medicine first."
Zheng Yuan asked his younger sister Zheng Xuan to take the money and go out.
